sandboxHelp.title: The sandbox is not available
sandboxHelp.body: This system blocks a security feature that {product} uses to keep websites isolated from each other and from your computer. {product} does not open websites without it.
sandboxHelp.fixHint: Needs your administrator password. {product} restarts afterwards.
sandboxHelp.packages: Get the deb or rpm package instead
sandboxHelp.failed: The sandbox could not be allowed. Please try the deb or rpm package.
newtab.title: New tab
newtab.private: This is a private window. Astela keeps no history of the pages you open here and deletes their cookies and other data when you close the last private window. Files you download stay in your downloads folder.
settings.title: Settings
settings.searchUrlHint: An https address with %s where the search terms go.
settings.searchUrlInvalid: Enter an https address that contains %s.
shell.privateHint: Private window: pages here are not kept in the history, and their cookies and other data are deleted when the last private window closes.
settings.setupGuideNote: Choose the look, the tabs and the search engine step by step.
setup.title: Set up {product}
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to {product}
setup.welcome.body: Make {product} yours in a few steps: choose how it looks, where your tabs go and how you search. Every choice applies at once, and you can change it later in the settings.
setup.look.title: Choose your look
setup.look.body: Pick light or dark colors, or follow your system, and an accent color for buttons and highlights.
setup.layout.title: Arrange your tabs
setup.layout.body: Keep the tabs in a row above or below the page, or as a list at the side, which leaves room for many tabs.
setup.search.title: Pick your search engine
setup.search.body: The address bar and the new tab page search with it.
setup.done.title: You are all set
setup.done.body: {product} keeps your choices. To change them, open Settings from the menu at the right end of the toolbar.
settings.contentBlockerNote: Uses the filter lists that uBlock Origin enables by default, except Peter Lowe's list.
settings.contentBlockerFailed: Not working: the filter data is missing or damaged, so nothing is blocked. Reinstall the browser to repair it.
settings.cookieNoticesNote: Adds the lists of EasyList and uBlock Origin against cookie notices.
settings.annoyancesNote: Adds the lists of EasyList and uBlock Origin against newsletter boxes, chat and social widgets, notifications and other annoyances.
settings.allowedSitesNote: The blocker is off on these sites and their subdomains.
settings.allowedSitesInvalid: Enter the name of a site, such as example.com.
overlay.blockerOff: The content blocker is off. You can turn it on in the settings.
problem.notFound: The address of {site} could not be found.
problem.certificate: The certificate of {site} is not trusted. Someone could read or change what you send to the site.
problem.certificateRisk: Continue only if you know why the site has this certificate, such as a device in your own network.
problem.certificateManaged: Your organization does not allow continuing to such sites.
overlay.signInSite: {site} asks for a user name and password.
overlay.signInProxy: The proxy {site} asks for a user name and password.
overlay.signInInsecure: The connection is not encrypted, so others could read what you send.
find.label: Find in page
shell.blockerOff: Content blocker: off on this site
shell.blockerFailed: Content blocker: not working, its filter data is missing
history.title: History
history.clearConfirm: Remove every page from the history?
bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.name: Name
bookmarks.invalidAddress: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
import.title: Import from another browser
import.note: Bookmarks go into a folder of their own, which a later import of the same browser replaces. Open tabs open in new windows.
import.failed: Some data could not be read; close {browser} and try again.
import.none: No other browsers found on this computer.
import.managed: Your organization turned off the import.
setup.import.title: Bring your bookmarks along
setup.import.body: Import bookmarks and history from the browser you used so far. It stays as it is, and you can import later in the settings, too.
defaultBrowser.title: Default browser
defaultBrowser.not: Links from other apps open in another browser.
defaultBrowser.windows: Choose {product} in the Windows settings that opened.
defaultBrowser.unsupported: This kind of installation cannot become the default browser.
defaultBrowser.failed: The system did not accept the change.
setup.browser.title: Blocker and default browser
setup.browser.body: {product} blocks ads and trackers from the start. As your default browser, it also opens the links from other apps.
shell.bookmarksBarEmpty: Pages you bookmark with the star appear here.
settings.bookmarksBarNote: Shows the bookmarks of the bookmarks bar folder below the toolbar.
overlay.permission.clipboard: See text and images that you copy
overlay.permissionNote: Astela keeps your answer for this site. You can change it in the settings.
settings.sitePermissionsNote: What sites may use after you answered their question. Remove an entry, and the site asks again.
settings.changedNone: No setting differs from its default.
settings.resetAllQuestion: Reset all settings to their defaults? Settings that your organization manages stay as they are.
settings.importSkipped: Imported settings: {count}. Skipped, as your organization manages them or they are not valid: {skipped}
settings.importInvalid: This file holds no settings of Astela.
settings.languageNote: Menus, dialogs and the pages of Astela
settings.restartNeeded: Some changes take effect after a restart.
settings.textSize.keywords: font size bigger smaller zoom readable
settings.fontNote: The name of a font on this computer, such as Inter. Empty uses the font of the system.
settings.fontInvalid: Use letters, digits, spaces, dots, hyphens and underscores only.
settings.webTextSizeNote: For pages that set no size. Tabs that open after a change use it.
settings.webTextSize.keywords: font size zoom bigger smaller readable
settings.webFontsNote: For pages that name no font. An empty field keeps the default. Tabs that open after a change use them.
settings.startupPagesNote: They open in this order, and only the first loads before you show the others.
settings.startupPagesNone: None yet. Without pages, the browser starts with a new tab page.
settings.addressInvalid: Enter a web address, such as example.com or https://example.com/page.
settings.homeButtonNote: A button next to Reload opens the home page in the current tab.
settings.homePageNote: The page of the home button and its shortcut. Empty opens the new tab page.
settings.pageZoomNote: For sites that you have not zoomed yourself.
settings.pageZoom.keywords: zoom size bigger smaller magnify scale
settings.downloadFolderSystem: The downloads folder of the system
settings.downloadAsk: Ask where to save each file
settings.downloadAskNote: The browser asks before it saves a download, and suggests the folder above.
settings.searchEnginesNote: Type a keyword and a space before a search in the address bar to search with that engine.
settings.searchEngineInvalid: Give a name, a keyword that is free, has no spaces and starts with neither ! nor @, and an https address with %s for the search.
settings.bangsNote: Such as !w for Wikipedia or !gh for GitHub, at the start or the end of a search in the address bar.
settings.toolbarNote: The buttons next to the address bar, in this order. Downloads shows after the first download.
settings.newTabSearchNote: The address bar searches as well.
settings.newTabClockNote: The time of your computer, above the search field.
settings.newTabTilesNote: Up to 12 pages that the new tab page shows below the search field.
settings.newTab.keywords: tiles speed dial start page favorites
settings.clearDataNote: The history, cookies and site data, and the cache of regular windows.
settings.clearData.keywords: delete remove history cookies cache privacy
settings.clearDataCookies: Cookies and other site data, which signs you out of most sites
settings.clearDataAll: The time range applies to the history; cookies, site data and the cache are always cleared completely.
